facts.business: Safa Systems & Technologies Limited is engaged in the sale of products, recognizing revenue on dispatch to customers, and earns interest income on bank deposits.

guidance_or_targets.statement: The Board of Directors and the Management of the Company are pursuing various available options to rehabilitate the Company and considering future business plans for the Company.
